title: Compare the candidate heights · Set 3
statement:
Find the absolute minimum height of $x^3-3([$a])^2x$ on $[-2([$a]),2([$a])]$.

[__________]{a}
hints: Enter the minimum height, even if more than one input attains it.
solution: Test $-2a,-a,a,2a$. The heights are $-2a^3,2a^3,-2a^3,2a^3$, so the minimum is $-2([$a])^3$.
